expectations.text: Identifies SQL injection in app/api/orders/route.ts caused by interpolating the status query parameter into $queryRawUnsafe
expectations.evidence: #1 Critical app/api/orders/route.ts:11-15 SQL injection via status in $queryRawUnsafe

expectations.text: Identifies that DELETE in app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts deletes any order by id without checking it belongs to the current user (IDOR / missing ownership check)
expectations.evidence: #6 High 'IDOR: delete other users' orders', where: { id } without userId

expectations.text: Identifies that updateProfile in app/actions/profile.ts lacks authentication/authorization (trusts userId argument) and/or spreads formData into the update allowing fields like role to be set (mass assignment)
expectations.evidence: #2 Critical updateProfile no auth, trusts client userId, mass assignment (role)

expectations.text: Identifies stored XSS risk from dangerouslySetInnerHTML with product.description in app/products/[slug]/page.tsx
expectations.evidence: #7 High Stored XSS via dangerouslySetInnerHTML with product.description

expectations.text: Identifies that useEffect in app/dashboard/page.tsx has no dependency array, causing it to refetch on every render (infinite loop / request storm)
expectations.evidence: #9 High useEffect without dependency array causes endless fetch

expectations.text: Identifies that lib/config.ts reads the Stripe secret key from a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable and/or that it is imported into a client component, exposing the secret to the browser
expectations.evidence: #3 Critical NEXT_PUBLIC_ secret key imported into client component

expectations.text: Identifies that the empty catch in app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts swallows errors and still returns success
expectations.evidence: #4 'empty catch (err) {} then responds 200 { received: true } in every case'

expectations.text: Identifies that the Stripe webhook handler does not verify the webhook signature before trusting the event
expectations.evidence: #4 Critical 'Webhook does not verify signature', fix with constructEvent

expectations.text: Identifies that app/api/users/route.ts returns full user records (e.g. password hashes / sensitive fields) instead of selecting safe fields
expectations.evidence: #8 High returns whole User entity incl. password hash, fix with select

expectations.text: Mentions the use of the any type in app/api/users/route.ts as a type-safety issue
expectations.evidence: #13 Type safety: 'app/api/users/route.ts:12 — (u: any) unnecessary'

expectations.text: Identifies that app/api/checkout/route.ts uses the client-supplied item price instead of the product price from the database
expectations.evidence: #5 High subtotal from client item.price (line 24) and unitPrice (line 37) instead of DB price

expectations.text: Identifies that pricing/shipping/VAT business logic lives inside the checkout route handler and should be moved to a service/domain layer
expectations.evidence: #11 Medium 'Business logic (price, shipping, VAT) in route handler', move to lib/services/pricing.ts

expectations.text: Identifies the N+1 query pattern (findUnique inside a loop) in app/api/checkout/route.ts
expectations.evidence: #10 Medium 'N+1 query' findUnique per item in loop

expectations.text: Does NOT report rendering {review.body} as JSX text in the product page as an XSS vulnerability
expectations.evidence: Explicitly: review.body rendered as JSX text is escaped by React, not a problem

expectations.text: Does NOT report the $queryRaw tagged template in app/api/reviews/route.ts as SQL injection
expectations.evidence: Praised: '$queryRaw tagged template (parameterized)'

expectations.text: Does NOT report process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY used in the server-side app/api/reviews/route.ts as a secret exposed to the client
expectations.evidence: Says reviews/route.ts using process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is correct

expectations.text: Does NOT report createReview in app/actions/review.ts as missing authentication or input validation
expectations.evidence: createReview praised as good pattern; #12 is only revalidatePath path mismatch

expectations.text: Every finding in code-review-report.md cites a file path with a line number or line range
expectations.evidence: All 13 findings cite file:line (#13 lists lib/auth.ts:8, users/route.ts:12, orders/route.ts:13-15, reviews/route.ts:6,23-24)

expectations.text: Every finding in code-review-report.md is assigned an explicit severity level (Critical/High/Medium/Low or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: All 13 findings have explicit Severity

expectations.text: Every finding rated Critical or High in code-review-report.md includes a concrete code fix, not only a prose suggestion
expectations.evidence: All Critical (#1-4) and High (#5-9) include code blocks with concrete fixes
